title: Administrative Litigation and Civic Redress
goal: I can say that a citizen can go to court against an administrative decision (*közigazgatási per*).
I can say what a claim asks of the court (*megsemmisítés*, *megváltoztatás*).
I can say that discretion is not arbitrariness (*mérlegelési jogkör*).
